diagnosis: The PrescriptionResource exposes the prescribing doctor's federal DEA registration number and confidential risk assessment notes directly in patient-facing API responses. Patients or third parties with read access can harvest physician DEA credentials to forge controlled substance prescriptions.
exploit_request:
GET /api/prescriptions/4021 HTTP/1.1
Host: rx.telemed-rx.com
Authorization: Bearer 81|patienttoken98765
Accept: application/json
